findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_campaign_results, get_session_nonce, get_login_nonce, verify_login_signature · Private data: create_account, get_account, get_agent_config, get_session_nonce, initialize_session, verify_payment, validate_campaign, create_campaign, verify_campaign_funding, verify_campaign_activation, get_login_nonce, verify_login_signature, list_campaigns, get_campaign_details, export_campaign_data · Public sink: create_account, create_card_topup, list_my_campaigns, get_campaign, initialize_session · Destructive: get_campaign_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_campaign_results, get_session_nonce, get_login_nonce, verify_login_signature · Private data: create_account, get_account, get_agent_config, get_session_nonce, initialize_session, verify_payment, validate_campaign, create_campaign, verify_campaign_funding, verify_campaign_activation, get_login_nonce, verify_login_signature, list_campaigns, get_campaign_details, export_campaign_data · Public sink: create_account, create_card_topup, list_my_campaigns, get_campaign, initialize_session · Destructive: get_campaign_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
